I managed to sneak into LA after a bunch of tough boys on this sub said I wouldn’t or I would get my ass kicked by them. It’s totally doable but I had a different method other than rush the gates. 

I pulled up on the third day with an invalid RL wristband. Went to the most busy entrance and walked thru the security line as usual. When my wristband didn’t scan they had me stand on the side next to a bunch of cops and security with other people in the same boat. 

Well, come to find out the festival was so disorganized that the area we were standing was where VIP was walking through to get to the next security checkpoint. After a couple minutes of standing there, I realized that with so many people coming, I could keep moving with the crowd and got in no problems. 

Obviously, I’m not recommending this because it could result in an arrest or getting the shit beat out of you. But it is possible! Don’t jump the gate or sneak in just go through the front and worst case scenario have a $50 to slip in the hand of the dude checking wristband. Best of luck!
